correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructed: all coordinate critical values solve one cubic in char2; the multiplicity partition check restricts reduced support to 15 coordinate and six diagonal frame lines. Hessian transverse rank four away from frame points establishes generically reduced line branches. The 21-line normalized curve has 7 ordinary six-branch frame points, each with local normalization quotient length six, giving P_red(d)=21d-21. Independently enumerated GF2 monomial Hilbert ranks in degrees 0..9, as 1,6,21,50,91,132,162,182,203,224; a fresh SymPy GF2 grevlex Groebner calculation independently obtained 49 polynomials and leading-degree counts 6,7,13,12,9,2 for degrees 3..8, supporting the asserted full Hilbert series P_Y(d)=21d+35. Difference 56 is supported at seven vertices; characteristic-two transpositions with F(T_i x)=F(x)+x_i^4 generate S7 and equal length 8 defects. Stabilizer upper bound from unique six-valent frame vertices. Full primary decomposition not claimed, and gradient scheme differs from singular scheme V(e4).
